hadur117.core.melee
Melee (free-for-all) subsystems: opponent tracking, sweep radar, minimum-risk movement, target selection, circular targeting and posture strategy, and each opponent's melee profile block (MMEM-1), driven each tick by MeleeController.

    (package private) Point2D.Double
    MinimumRiskMovement.dodgeBest(List<Point2D.Double> candidates, MinimumRiskMovement.View v, List<MinimumRiskMovement.Wave> waves)
    TMODE-27, Ogi's dodge: the TeamDodge.RERANK lowest-risk candidates, and the destination held if not reached, are each driven to through the shot profiles waves for MinimumRiskMovement.WAVE_TICKS ticks and through the teammates' bullets for MinimumRiskMovement.PATH_TICKS; scored as MinimumRiskMovement.waveScores(double[], double[]), the held destination times MinimumRiskMovement.SWITCH_GAIN.

    (package private) Point2D.Double
    MinimumRiskMovement.pathBest(List<Point2D.Double> candidates, MinimumRiskMovement.View v)
    TMODE-25, Firestarter's path check: the MinimumRiskMovement.PATH_RERANK lowest-risk candidates and the destination held if not reached are each scored as their risk plus MinimumRiskMovement.PATH_K times the damage of the teammates' bullets their drive would meet in MinimumRiskMovement.PATH_TICKS ticks.
    (package private) Point2D.Double

    TMODE-11, TMODE-27: the rerank lowest-risk candidates, and the destination held if not reached, each driven to through the waves for MinimumRiskMovement.WAVE_TICKS ticks and through the teammates' bullets for MinimumRiskMovement.PATH_TICKS; scored as MinimumRiskMovement.waveScores(double[], double[]), the held destination times MinimumRiskMovement.SWITCH_GAIN.

    The whole risk of p.
    (package private) static void
    MinimumRiskMovement.screen(MinimumRiskMovement.View v, long now)
    TMODE-6: a teammate screens Hadur from an enemy as another enemy does: each enemy's distance to its nearest other robot, which decides whether Hadur at a point would be its closest (MMOVE-2), takes the living teammates in view too (Ogi counts every robot nearer the enemy, teammates included).
    (package private) Point2D.Double
    MinimumRiskMovement.surfBest(List<Point2D.Double> candidates, MinimumRiskMovement.View v)
    MMOVE-15: the melee surfer's wave check, with MMOVE-17's scores and MMOVE-18's shadows when on.
    (package private) double
    MinimumRiskMovement.teammateRisk(Point2D.Double p, MinimumRiskMovement.View v)
    MMOVE-6, MMOVE-7: for each living teammate with a fresh position, its predicted point when Hadur would arrive at p scores MinimumRiskMovement.MATE_K over the inverse square of the distance (floored at MinimumRiskMovement.MATE_FLOOR), and the path from Hadur to p scores MinimumRiskMovement.MATE_PATH_K for passing within MinimumRiskMovement.MATE_PATH_RANGE of the teammate's predicted track from now until then.
    (package private) Point2D.Double
    MinimumRiskMovement.waveBest(List<Point2D.Double> candidates, MinimumRiskMovement.View v)
    TMODE-11, Ogi's wave check: the MinimumRiskMovement.WAVE_RERANK lowest-risk candidates, and the destination held if not reached, are each driven to for MinimumRiskMovement.WAVE_TICKS ticks, and every shot in flight that crosses Hadur's box on the way counts the share of it aimed there.
